name: glim
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: glim
  version: "1.2.1"
  build_number: 5

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/koide3/glim/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: baa367009dff6fdcaacf87d53c2a4e2add4ac4d6668e85ebc56b2aa6432b1f14
    patches:
      - 0001-fix-fmt-ptr-shared-ptr.patch
      - 0002-unvendor-json.patch

build:
  skip: not linux
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  # Explicit build string suffix to easily differentiate CPU and CUDA builds.
  string: ${{ "cpu" if cuda_compiler_version == "None" else "cuda" + (cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '')) }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  # Native rattler-build support for prioritizing CUDA over CPU builds.
  # The CPU variant receives a penalty (1), allowing the solver to prefer CUDA (0).
  # This works in combination with the __cuda virtual package constraint in the run requirements.
  variant:
    use_keys:
      - cuda_compiler_version
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if cuda_compiler_version == "None" else 0 }}

outputs:
  # =============
  # Package: glim
  # =============
  - package:
      name: glim
    build:
      script:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - test -n "$CUDAARCHS"
            - echo $CUDAARCHS
        - cmake -S . -B build -GNinja
          ${{ "${CMAKE_ARGS}" if not win else "%CMAKE_ARGS%" }}
          -DBUILD_WITH_VIEWER=OFF
          -DBUILD_WITH_MARCH_NATIVE=OFF
          -DBUILD_WITH_OPENCV=ON
          -DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets"
          -DBUILD_WITH_CUDA=${{ "ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "OFF" }}
          -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="${CUDAARCHS-}"
        - cmake --build build --config Release
        - cmake --install build/ --config Release
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - fmt
        - gtsam >=4.2
        - gtsam-points-devel >=1.2.0 ${{ "cuda*" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu*" }}
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - libboost-devel
        - libopencv
        - nlohmann_json
        - spdlog
        - tbb-devel
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
            - cuda-cudart-dev
      run:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            # The __cuda virtual package acts as a hardware lock.
            # It prevents the solver from picking the prioritized CUDA build on a CPU-only machine,
            # forcing a graceful fallback to the CPU build.
            - __cuda
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - glim/util/config.hpp
          lib:
            - glim
            - odometry_estimation_ct
            - odometry_estimation_cpu
            - sub_mapping
            - sub_mapping_passthrough
            - global_mapping
            - global_mapping_pose_graph
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then: odometry_estimation_gpu
  # ===================
  # Package: glim-devel
  # ===================
  - package:
      name: glim-devel
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('glim', exact=True) }}
        - eigen
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - gtsam-points-devel >=1.2.0 ${{ "cuda*" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu*" }}
        - libboost-devel
        - nlohmann_json
        - tbb-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('glim', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - cmake-package-check glim --targets glim
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - cmake
            - cmake-package-check
            - ninja
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}

about:
  homepage: https://koide3.github.io/glim/
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/koide3/glim
  summary: Versatile and extensible point cloud-based 3D localization and mapping framework.

extra:
  feedstock-name: glim
  recipe-maintainers:
    - diegoferigo
